Best-on-best international hockey

Source: R/international.R
nhl_international.Rd

The NHL's records of the tournaments its players have played in: the Canada Cup (1976 to 1991), the World Cup of Hockey (1996, 2004, 2016), the Olympics (1998 to 2014, and 2026) and the 4 Nations Face-Off (2025).

Usage

nhl_international(
  type = c("skater", "goalie", "team"),
  tournament = NULL,
  year = NULL
)

nhl_international_careers(type = c("skater", "goalie"), olympics = FALSE)

nhl_international_games(tournament = NULL, year = NULL)

nhl_international_winners()

nhl_olympic_podiums()

Arguments

type

"skater", "goalie" or, for nhl_international(), "team".

tournament

"olympics", "world cup", "canada cup" or "4 nations"; NULL for all of them.

year

Year or years the tournament was played; NULL for all.

olympics

TRUE for Olympic careers and medals.

Value

A tibble.

Details

  • nhl_international(): every player's or club's numbers at each tournament, with skaters' ice time from 2010 on.

  • nhl_international_careers(): career totals across the Canada Cup, World Cup and 4 Nations, or with olympics = TRUE, across the Olympics, with medals.

  • nhl_international_games(): every game, with the round, score, goalies, coaches, three stars and the winning goal. The game ids work with nhl_pbp() and nhl_boxscore(): full play-by-play for the 4 Nations and the 2016 World Cup, goals and penalties for the Olympics.

  • nhl_international_winners(): the game that decided each tournament, with the captains, the winning goalie and who scored the winner.

  • nhl_olympic_podiums(): gold, silver and bronze at each Olympics, with captains and coaches.

Tournaments are named by the year they were played (year = 2026), not the NHL season they fell in.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # interactive()
# Scoring at the 2026 Olympics:
oly <- nhl_international("skater", "olympics", 2026)
head(oly[, c("first_name", "last_name", "tri_code", "games_played", "goals", "assists", "points")])

# Every 4 Nations game, then the final's play-by-play:
games <- nhl_international_games("4 nations")
nhl_pbp(games$game_id[games$series_title == "Final"])

nhl_international_careers("skater")
nhl_international_careers("goalie", olympics = TRUE)
nhl_international_winners()
nhl_olympic_podiums()
}
